title: AI-Associated Lexical Shifts Across 34 Languages: Cross-Lingual Convergence and Diachronic Uptake in News Writing

live_model.evidence: Limitations/Model-versions: "...GPT-3.5 Turbo rho=0.918, GPT-4 rho=0.857, GPT-4 Turbo rho=0.930, and GPT-4o rho=0.956...", supporting GPT-4.1-mini as a proxy for models used during the target period.

prompt.location: System-prompt sensitivity section (e.g. "Continue the input text. Output only the continuation."); Appendix A (cost/model-matching rationale)
prompt.note: Main task is direct text continuation from corpus text (model receives the first half of a sentence), not a fixed engineered template.

claim.metric: Spearman rho vs. GPT-4.1-mini lexical-overuse lists (cross-version robustness check)
claim.location: Limitations section (Historical model matching / Model-versions paragraph)

data.source: Public multilingual news corpus (2020-2021 continuations, 34 languages)

notes: The paper's primary model is GPT-4.1-mini (not itself one of the tracked retiring identifiers); GPT-4-Turbo appears only in a secondary validation comparison limited to 20k continuations per model, with overlap n~1,100-1,300 after a low-count guard (reported as a range, not an exact figure). Undated GPT-4o also appears in the same comparison (rho=0.956) but is not the primary claim here.
